$comment: The concept -> export map. Documentation groups by what a reader recognises; the package exports by unit. One doc page can cover several exports, and this file records which - so a designer reads one page and an engineer still knows what to import. Fields describe WHAT THE SYSTEM DECIDES for each export, never which upstream component it maps to: the underlying library is not the subject and must not reach reader-facing output. Committed and diffable; consumed by emit-components.mjs. See TITAN-DIV-10.

prominence.$comment: The design vocabulary for button weight, matching the naming specification's prominence axis. Code uses different variant values; this maps them. Reader-facing output leads with the design term.

components/actions/link.title: Link
components/actions/link.$comment: Reader-facing name is Link — the design vocabulary's term for a styled hyperlink. The package's own export named `Link` is a different thing entirely (a React Router wrapper); the styled element is exported as `TextLink`. See TITAN-DIV-25.
